name: B10-0435/2026 – After § 29 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: 29. Welcomes the readmission conditionality introduced in the revised GSP Regulation1a, which links the EU’s trade preferences to cooperation on migration; calls on the Commission to make full and effective use of this mechanism regarding African beneficiaries when necessary; calls on the Commission to report regularly to Parliament on the state of readmission cooperation of African GSP beneficiaries and on any steps taken under the mechanism; considers that the same principle of consistency between trade preferences and migration cooperation should guide future EPA reviews and the negotiation of new trade agreements with African countries; –––––––––––––––––––––––– 1a Regulation (EU) 2026/1395 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 June 2026 on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 (OJ L, 2026/1395, 22.6.2026, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/1395/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/1395/oj)).
